pain_points.statement: Finance is three weeks behind on invoicing due to data discrepancies across systems, stalling cash flow.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

desired_state.statement: Automated reconciliation between delivery records and financial records to eliminate invoicing backlogs.
desired_state.source_excerpt: if we fix invoicing reconciliation, the secondary metric is days-sales-outstanding, which should drop from where we are now back to industry standard

success_criteria.statement: Reduce Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) from 3 weeks behind to the industry standard of approximately 5 days.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: days-sales-outstanding, which should drop from where we are now back to industry standard, which is about five days.

risks_unknowns.statement: CFO skepticism from a past bad vendor experience puts strict constraints on budget release and milestone performance.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've been burned by vendors who quoted big and delivered late.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers are forced to manually act as the integration layer between Routemaster, Salesforce, and the mobile driver app.
pain_points.source_excerpt: So it's three systems for one assignment, and the dispatcher is the integration layer.

desired_state.statement: An integrated technical workflow linking Routemaster, Salesforce, and driver communication built incrementally.
desired_state.source_excerpt: I need a partner who can help me make the case for incremental change instead of a full rebuild.

success_criteria.statement: Data sync accuracy across Routemaster, Salesforce, and driver PODs to prevent manual detective work in finance.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: The driver might mark a load delivered at 2pm in the app, but the actual proof of delivery shows 4pm... so finance is doing detective work on every single invoice.

risks_unknowns.statement: Stakeholders disagree on whether to perform an incremental upgrade or a complete system rebuild of Routemaster.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Marcus will want to dig into the technical approach — he has strong opinions about Routemaster because he built half of it... He's been pushing for that for a year.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: CTO Marcus Patel wants a full custom rebuild of Routemaster (a 12-month minimum effort), whereas VP of Operations Sarah Chen mandates an incremental approach to achieve a Q3 pilot.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers spend 2 to 3 hours daily on phone calls with drivers due to a feature-deficient mobile app.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Every dispatcher tells me they spend two to three hours a day on the phone with drivers because the app doesn't do what they need.

desired_state.statement: Streamlined dispatcher workflow that reduces processing friction and enables drivers to handle updates directly in-app.
desired_state.source_excerpt: They can't take photos, they can't flag issues, they can't message the dispatcher.

success_criteria.statement: Reduce average load processing time per dispatcher from 12 minutes down to 8 minutes.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: Right now our average dispatcher takes about twelve minutes to fully process a load through all three systems. If we can get that to eight minutes — call it a thirty percent reduction

risks_unknowns.statement: An upcoming federal ELD compliance update in November owned by compliance may introduce unforeseen workflow constraints.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: There's an ELD compliance deadline in November — federal mandate update. Rajiv, our head of compliance, owns it.

pain_points.statement: Incomplete technical integration from 2024 acquisitions combined with 40% growth creates severe operational bottlenecks.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Northwind grew 40% in 2024 by acquiring two smaller brokerages. Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: Implement operational efficiencies through Phase 1 to avoid adding dispatcher headcount next year while scaling.
desired_state.source_excerpt: that's a real productivity win and it pays for itself in headcount we don't have to hire next year.

success_criteria.statement: Deploy a measurable pilot into production by the end of Q3 (September 30) to secure continued Phase 1 funding.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: Q3 is because Rita — our CFO — agreed to the budget on the condition that we have something measurable in production by end of September.

risks_unknowns.statement: Failure to demonstrate measurable progress by Q3 will cause the CFO to pull funding and reallocate it to other initiatives.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Otherwise the funding gets pulled into other projects.
